svg.title: Spirals from falling momentum
svg.desc: A delta ray spiralling in liquid hydrogen, and a process track spiralling toward its home as its CPU falls.
svg.text: Falling momentum, shrinking radius, an inward spiral
r = p / (0.3 B) holds at every instant; only p changes along the track.
A 2 MeV delta ray (electron, anticlockwise), liquid H2, B = 1.5 T
range 6.8 cm; starts at r = 0.55 cm
A process track as specified (q > 0, clockwise)
CPU = 0.05 + 1.6 exp(-t / 14 s); track ends when CPU < 0.10
